title: ClockCadenceParams
description: Simulation tick cadence. SPEC-SIM-6: ticks_per_month parameterises the sub-monthly clock. Dynamics params are scaled automatically so the macro trajectory is invariant to cadence choice.

ticks_per_month.description: Number of simulation ticks per calendar month. 1 = monthly (unchanged behavior), 4 = weekly, 30 ≈ daily. Session.advance(months) internally runs ticks_per_month dynamics steps per calendar month with params scaled by scaleParamsForTick.
